# frozen_string_literal: true
# MIT. Retained Ruby business operations over original SF88 dataset sessions.
require_relative "dataset_delivery"
require_relative "rails_receiving"

module Starforge
  class DatasetReceiving
    JOB_SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.ruby-dataset-job.v1"
    attr_reader :directory, :dataset_id

    def self.key_id(key)
      Receiving.key_id(key)
    end
    def self.dataset_id(key)
      "ruby-dataset:" + key_id(key)
    end
    def self.directory_for(directory, key, create: false)
      root = Files.directory(directory,create: create)
      datasets = Files.directory(File.join(root,"datasets"),create: create)
      Files.directory(File.join(datasets,key_id(key)),create: create)
    end
    def self.retained_job(directory:, key:)
      path = directory_for(directory,key)
      raw = Files.read(File.join(path,"job.json"),262_144)
      job = Files.parse(raw)
      Files.need(job["schema"] == JOB_SCHEMA && job["keySha256"] == key_id(key) &&
        job["datasetId"] == dataset_id(key), "RUBY_DATASET_JOB_CHANGED")
      {"directory"=>path,"bytes"=>raw,"job"=>job}
    end
    def self.received(directory:, key:, expected_manifest_sha256: nil)
      saved = retained_job(directory: directory,key: key)
      job, path = saved.fetch("job"),saved.fetch("directory")
      receipt = Files.parse(Files.read(File.join(path,"received.json"),262_144))
      Files.need(receipt["schema"] == "stellar-forge.ruby-dataset-received.v1" &&
        receipt["jobSha256"] == Files.hash(saved.fetch("bytes")) && receipt["datasetId"] == job["datasetId"] &&
        receipt["sourceSha256"] == job["sourceSha256"] && receipt["directory"] == File.join(path,"received") &&
        (expected_manifest_sha256.nil? || receipt["manifestSha256"] == expected_manifest_sha256),
        "RUBY_DATASET_RECEIPT_CHANGED")
      delivery = DatasetDelivery.open(receipt.fetch("directory"),expected_manifest_sha256: receipt.fetch("manifestSha256"))
      request_bytes = Files.read(File.join(path,"request","request.json"),MAX_INPUT)
      request = Files.parse(request_bytes)
      Files.need(Files.hash(request_bytes) == job["requestSha256"] &&
        request.is_a?(Hash) && request.all? { |name,value| name == "schema" || delivery.source[name] == value } &&
        delivery.manifest["datasetId"] == job["datasetId"] && delivery.source_sha256 == job["sourceSha256"] &&
        delivery.source["rubyManifestSha256"] == job["rubyManifestSha256"] &&
        delivery.selection["limits"] == job["limits"] && delivery.selection["originalSession"] == job["originalSession"] &&
        (job["expectedSnapshot"].nil? || delivery.selection["expectedSnapshot"] == job["expectedSnapshot"]) &&
        delivery.manifest["selectionSha256"] == receipt["selectionSha256"] &&
        delivery.manifest["intentId"] == receipt["intentId"], "RUBY_DATASET_BUSINESS_DELIVERY_CHANGED")
      delivery
    end

    NEW_MAX_PAGES = 4096
    NEW_MAX_PAGE_BYTES = 2_097_152

    # Native historical definitions remain attachable with their original limits.
    # New acquisitions fit the paired original SF100 delivery implementation.
    def self.normalize_limits(limits, historical: false)
      Files.need(limits.is_a?(Hash) && (limits.keys - %w[maxPages maxTotalAtomic maxRows maxPageBytes]).empty?,
        "RUBY_DATASET_LIMITS_REQUIRED")
      value = {"maxPages"=>limits.fetch("maxPages"),"maxTotalAtomic"=>limits.fetch("maxTotalAtomic"),
        "maxRows"=>limits.fetch("maxRows",1_000_000),"maxPageBytes"=>limits.fetch("maxPageBytes",1_048_576)}
      Files.need(value["maxPages"].is_a?(Integer) && value["maxPages"].between?(1,historical ? 10_000 : NEW_MAX_PAGES) &&
        value["maxRows"].is_a?(Integer) && value["maxRows"].between?(1,1_000_000) &&
        value["maxPageBytes"].is_a?(Integer) && value["maxPageBytes"].between?(1024,historical ? 16_777_216 : NEW_MAX_PAGE_BYTES) &&
        value["maxTotalAtomic"].is_a?(String) && /\A[1-9][0-9]{0,38}\z/.match?(value["maxTotalAtomic"]) &&
        value["maxTotalAtomic"].to_i <= 170_141_183_460_469_231_731_687_303_715_884_105_727,
        "RUBY_DATASET_LIMITS_INVALID")
      value
    end

    def initialize(client:, buyer:, directory:, key:, bound:, limits:, expected_snapshot: nil, original_session: nil)
      Files.need(client.is_a?(SellerClient) && buyer.is_a?(Buyer) && bound.is_a?(BoundRequest),
        "RUBY_DATASET_BUSINESS_SOURCE_REQUIRED")
      @client,@buyer,@key,@bound = client,buyer,key.dup.freeze,bound
      @dataset_id = self.class.dataset_id(key).freeze
      Files.need(bound.intent_id == @dataset_id && bound.source_sha256 == client.source.fetch("sourceSha256") &&
        bound.body.nil? && bound.describe.dig("request","method") == "GET", "RUBY_DATASET_GET_REQUEST_REQUIRED")
      @limits = self.class.normalize_limits(limits,historical: !original_session.nil?)
      Files.need(expected_snapshot.nil? || HASH.match?(expected_snapshot.to_s), "RUBY_DATASET_SNAPSHOT_INVALID")
      @expected_snapshot = expected_snapshot
      @original_session = if original_session.nil?
        nil
      else
        Files.need(original_session.is_a?(Hash) && original_session.keys.sort == %w[directory sha256] &&
          HASH.match?(original_session["sha256"].to_s), "RUBY_DATASET_ORIGINAL_SESSION_REQUIRED")
        {"directory"=>Files.directory(original_session.fetch("directory")),"sha256"=>original_session.fetch("sha256")}
      end
      @root = Files.directory(directory,create: true)
      @directory = self.class.directory_for(@root,key,create: true)
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        bound.save(File.join(@directory,"request"))
        plan = Files.read(File.join(@directory,"request","request-plan.json"),262_144)
        job = {"schema"=>JOB_SCHEMA,"keySha256"=>self.class.key_id(key),"datasetId"=>@dataset_id,
          "buyerDirectory"=>buyer.directory,"sourceSha256"=>bound.source_sha256,
          "rubyManifestSha256"=>client.manifest_sha256,"requestPlanSha256"=>Files.hash(plan),
          "requestSha256"=>Files.hash(bound.record_bytes),"limits"=>@limits,
          "expectedSnapshot"=>@expected_snapshot,"originalSession"=>@original_session}
        @job_bytes = Files.json(job).freeze
        @job_sha256 = Files.hash(@job_bytes).freeze
        Files.once(File.join(@directory,"job.json"),@job_bytes)
        %w[reviews actions].each { |name| Files.directory(File.join(@directory,name),create: true) }
      end
    end

    def same_job!
      Files.need(Files.read(File.join(@directory,"job.json"),262_144) == @job_bytes, "RUBY_DATASET_JOB_CHANGED")
    end
    def complete?
      File.file?(File.join(@directory,"received.json"))
    end
    def delivery
      self.class.received(directory: @root,key: @key)
    end
    def native_call(action, arguments = {}, **options)
      @buyer.invoke("dataset."+action,@dataset_id,{"sourceSha256"=>@bound.source_sha256}.merge(arguments),**options)
    end
    private :native_call

    # The generated source and initial request are prepared offline. Creating or
    # attaching the original native session does not acquire any page.
    def prepare(cancel: nil)
      Files.lock(@directory) { same_job!; prepare_inside(cancel: cancel) }
    end
    def prepare_inside(cancel: nil)
      path = File.join(@directory,"prepared.json")
      if File.exist?(path)
        saved = Files.parse(Files.read(path,262_144))
        Files.need(saved["jobSha256"] == @job_sha256 && saved["datasetId"] == @dataset_id &&
          saved.dig("native","datasetId") == @dataset_id && HASH.match?(saved.dig("native","selectionSha256").to_s),
          "RUBY_DATASET_PREPARATION_CHANGED")
        return saved.fetch("native")
      end
      selected = @client.load_request(File.join(@directory,"request"))
      Files.need(selected.record_bytes == @bound.record_bytes, "RUBY_DATASET_REQUEST_CHANGED")
      @client.prepare(@buyer,selected,cancel: cancel)
      result = native_call("prepare",{"limits"=>@limits,"expectedSnapshot"=>@expected_snapshot,
        "originalSession"=>@original_session},cancel: cancel)
      Files.need(result.is_a?(Hash) && result["datasetId"] == @dataset_id &&
        result.dig("selection","sourceSha256") == @bound.source_sha256 &&
        HASH.match?(result["selectionSha256"].to_s), "RUBY_DATASET_PREPARATION_CHANGED")
      Files.once(path,Files.json({"schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-dataset-prepared.v1",
        "jobSha256"=>@job_sha256,"datasetId"=>@dataset_id,"native"=>result}))
      result
    end
    private :prepare_inside

    def retain_review(value)
      Files.need(value.is_a?(Hash) && value["schema"] == "stellar-forge.ruby-dataset-review.v1" &&
        value["datasetId"] == @dataset_id && HASH.match?(value["reviewSha256"].to_s),
        "RUBY_DATASET_REVIEW_INVALID")
      Files.once(File.join(@directory,"reviews",value.fetch("reviewSha256")+".json"),Files.json(value))
      value
    end
    private :retain_review

    def review(cancel: nil)
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        same_job!
        prepare_inside(cancel: cancel)
        retain_review(native_call("review",{},cancel: cancel))
      end
    end
    def recover(cancel: nil)
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        same_job!
        return {"state"=>"RECEIVED","datasetId"=>@dataset_id,"delivery"=>delivery.manifest} if complete?
        prepare_inside(cancel: cancel)
        retain_review(native_call("recover",{},cancel: cancel))
      end
    end
    def status(cancel: nil)
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        same_job!
        return {"state"=>"RECEIVED","datasetId"=>@dataset_id,"delivery"=>delivery.manifest} if complete?
        unless File.exist?(File.join(@directory,"prepared.json"))
          return {"state"=>"REQUEST_RETAINED","datasetId"=>@dataset_id}
        end
        native_call("status",{},cancel: cancel)
      end
    end

    # An explicit caller action owns this stable key. Retrying it reopens the
    # exact same call; a later continuation needs a fresh review and action key.
    # Recovery observes existing native attempts and never acquires a new page.
    def run(review:, action_key:, cancel: nil)
      action_id = self.class.key_id(action_key)
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        same_job!
        prepared = prepare_inside(cancel: cancel)
        Files.need(review.is_a?(Hash) && HASH.match?(review["reviewSha256"].to_s) &&
          review["datasetId"] == @dataset_id && review["selectionSha256"] == prepared["selectionSha256"],
          "RUBY_DATASET_REVIEW_CHANGED")
        review_bytes = Files.read(File.join(@directory,"reviews",review.fetch("reviewSha256")+".json"),MAX_INPUT)
        Files.need(review_bytes == Files.json(review), "RUBY_DATASET_REVIEW_CHANGED")
        scope = Files.directory(File.join(@directory,"actions",action_id),create: true)
        path = File.join(scope,"request.json")
        plan = if File.exist?(path)
          Files.parse(Files.read(path,262_144))
        else
          value = {"schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-dataset-action.v1","jobSha256"=>@job_sha256,
            "actionKeySha256"=>action_id,"datasetId"=>@dataset_id,"reviewSha256"=>Files.hash(review_bytes),
            "callId"=>SecureRandom.uuid}
          Files.once(path,Files.json(value))
          value
        end
        Files.need(plan["schema"] == "stellar-forge.ruby-dataset-action.v1" &&
          plan["jobSha256"] == @job_sha256 && plan["actionKeySha256"] == action_id &&
          plan["datasetId"] == @dataset_id && plan["reviewSha256"] == Files.hash(review_bytes) &&
          CALL_ID.match?(plan["callId"].to_s), "RUBY_DATASET_ACTION_CHANGED")
        begin
          result = native_call("run",{"review"=>review},call_id: plan.fetch("callId"),cancel: cancel)
          retain_review(result)
          Files.once(File.join(scope,"result.json"),Files.json(result))
          result
        rescue Error => cause
          raise if cancel&.cancelled?
          observed = retain_review(native_call("recover",{},cancel: cancel))
          result = {"schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-dataset-action-recovery.v1",
            "outcome"=>"ORIGINAL_STATE_OBSERVED","datasetId"=>@dataset_id,
            "callId"=>plan.fetch("callId"),"originalError"=>cause.code,"review"=>observed}
          # Every recovery observation retains its own complete source result.
          Files.once(File.join(scope,"recovery-"+observed.fetch("reviewSha256")+".json"),Files.json(result))
          result
        end
      end
    end

    def receive(cancel: nil)
      Files.lock(@directory) do
        same_job!
        return delivery if complete?
        prepared = prepare_inside(cancel: cancel)
        result = native_call("receive",{"directory"=>File.join(@directory,"received")},cancel: cancel)
        Files.need(result.is_a?(Hash) && result["directory"] == File.join(@directory,"received") &&
          HASH.match?(result["manifestSha256"].to_s), "RUBY_DATASET_RECEIVING_RESULT_CHANGED")
        received = DatasetDelivery.open(result.fetch("directory"),expected_manifest_sha256: result.fetch("manifestSha256"))
        Files.need(received.manifest["datasetId"] == @dataset_id && received.source_sha256 == @bound.source_sha256 &&
          received.manifest["selectionSha256"] == prepared["selectionSha256"] &&
          received.manifest["intentId"] == prepared.dig("selection","nativeSessionId"),
          "RUBY_DATASET_BUSINESS_DELIVERY_CHANGED")
        Files.once(File.join(@directory,"received.json"),Files.json({
          "schema"=>"stellar-forge.ruby-dataset-received.v1","jobSha256"=>@job_sha256,
          "datasetId"=>@dataset_id,"intentId"=>received.manifest["intentId"],
          "sourceSha256"=>@bound.source_sha256,"selectionSha256"=>prepared["selectionSha256"],
          "directory"=>received.directory,"manifestSha256"=>received.manifest_sha256}))
        received
      end
    end
  end
end

# Import complete dataset editions into an existing Rails application

This example turns an original received SF88/SF100 dataset into a reviewed, repeatable database import. It includes the migration, application models, field mapping, background job and commissioning command. The importer keeps the application's existing tenant relation, target records, database connection and native dataset source together.

A complete preview shows every incoming and removed key. Committing that selected preview writes all target changes, current key state, original source rows, edition history and the final receipt in one Active Record transaction. A repeated business operation key reopens its original committed result.

## Install the application side

Use Ruby 3.1 or newer, Rails/Active Record 7.1 or newer and the application's existing database. The merchant package already includes the Ruby standard-library reader and source-bound Dataset receiving client. The application adds Active Record and Active Job through its normal Rails bundle.

Copy the example migration into the application's migration directory with an unused timestamp and run the application's usual migration command. The migration creates four import/history tables and one example target table:

| Table | Stored application state |
| --- | --- |
| starforge_dataset_streams | Tenant/name identity, source/key/scope bindings, current revision and latest edition |
| starforge_dataset_editions | Stable operation identity, selected preview and complete committed receipt |
| starforge_dataset_rows | Current exact source key, original target ID, active/removed state and last source values |
| starforge_dataset_entries | Every edition's original JSON row, exact changes, target ID and source position |
| starforge_dataset_catalog_records | Example tenant-scoped business records with an actual unique source key |

~~~sh
dataset_package=/absolute/customer-package
cp "$dataset_package/examples/rails_dataset/create_dataset_import_tables.rb" \
  db/migrate/20261012085000_create_dataset_import_tables.rb
bin/rails db:migrate
install -d -m 0700 tmp/dataset-review
~~~

Choose a new migration timestamp if that path already exists. Keep the delivered package hierarchy intact: the example models load the verified importer through its relative package path.

For a customer's established schema, keep the four history tables and replace the example CatalogRecord with the application's original model. The relation passed to RailsDataset must already enforce the authenticated tenant's record scope. The stream and all four model classes must use the very same Active Record connection pool. Add or retain a real unique index covering the selected key within that scope; for this example it is tenant_key plus external_id.

The model examples make completed editions and source entries immutable through normal Active Record writes. The stream and current-key state advance as later complete editions are committed. Retain all four history tables with the application's regular database backups.

## Receive the original complete dataset

Follow the merchant package's [Dataset receiving guide](../../DATASETS.md) to prepare, review, acquire or attach, receive, and reopen the original dataset. Retain its actual dataset-customer.json SHA-256 with the application import record.

The Rails side opens that completed directory offline. The receiving reader checks every required original file, whole-file byte count and SHA-256, final native status, full page/row range and projected field set before yielding rows. It parses original integer tokens as Ruby Integer and decimal tokens as BigDecimal; the original JSON spelling and row order remain available for each row.

The same completed packet can be reopened by a background job. Each iteration reads a private immutable verified snapshot. Original payment review, native acquisition and recovery belong to the existing merchant Dataset client.

## Map the customer's real fields

Copy mapping.json into the application's configuration and change its field names to the actual received dataset. Remove unused example mappings. Every mapped source field must appear in the received manifest's projected fields.

The included mapping expects these example source names: id, name, amount, quantity, active, observed_on and recorded_at. Their names are application examples; inspect the actual delivery's fields before selecting them:

~~~ruby
delivery = Starforge::DatasetDelivery.open(
  "/absolute/private/received-dataset",
  expected_manifest_sha256: actual_manifest_sha256
)
puts JSON.pretty_generate(delivery.fields)
~~~

The mapping has three decisions:

| Setting | Result |
| --- | --- |
| key_columns | Exact stable business key; one or several mapped target columns |
| columns | Source field and explicit native target type for each managed attribute |
| removal | Retain missing records, or set a separate Boolean archive column inactive |

Supported target types are string/text, integer, decimal, Boolean, date and datetime. A source integer stays exact. A decimal string or native decimal token is accepted only when the target column preserves its value and range. A datetime must carry an explicit UTC or numeric offset and fit the database column's precision. Date strings use YYYY-MM-DD. Boolean fields accept actual true/false values.

A string column accepts a string by default. Set stringify to true only when the application intentionally converts a numeric or Boolean source value to its literal text. Stable keys retain capitalization, whitespace and leading zeroes supplied as strings.

For each mapping, null is assign or preserve; missing is error or preserve. These are independent choices. Key columns always require an actual value. The original SF100 reader supplies the complete projected row shape, and a field left out of the application's mapping remains application-owned. Explicit null assignments must fit the target column's null constraint. Target primary keys, timestamps, lock versions, STI columns and fixed scope attributes cannot be overwritten by source mapping.

The supplied archive policy uses source_active:

~~~json
{
  "strategy": "archive",
  "column": "source_active",
  "active": true,
  "inactive": false
}
~~~

A key absent from a later complete selected dataset becomes removed in the import state and its original target record receives source_active=false. If the key reappears, its record becomes active and the preview reports restored. With {"strategy":"retain"}, removal changes the import history while preserving the target record's attributes.

Removals are calculated from previously managed active keys in this exact stream. The importer requires the original complete selection: a final native snapshot, original merchant contract, operation, resolved endpoint, selected query and tenant scope. Page cursor, page size and dataset snapshot can change as the same selected dataset advances. Changing the merchant contract, dataset endpoint, key definition or selected membership requires an explicit application migration or another authorized stream.

## Create the stable stream and review the complete edition

Run commissioning through the actual Rails application's runner so the original database and model configuration are loaded. Paths below are templates for the customer's retained package, received delivery, configuration and private output directory.

~~~sh
bin/rails runner "$dataset_package/examples/rails_dataset/commission.rb" init -- \
  --tenant account-42 --stream merchant-catalog

bin/rails runner "$dataset_package/examples/rails_dataset/commission.rb" preview -- \
  --tenant account-42 --stream merchant-catalog \
  --delivery /absolute/private/received-dataset \
  --manifest-sha256 ACTUAL_DATASET_CUSTOMER_MANIFEST_SHA256 \
  --mapping /absolute/application/config/dataset-catalog-mapping.json \
  --out /absolute/application/tmp/dataset-review
~~~

The preview command writes the entire JSON and CSV revision into files named by its full preview SHA-256. It also prints counts and the exact output descriptors. Every preview entry includes:

- Original source ordinal, original JSON line and row SHA-256.
- Exact stable key and existing native target ID.
- Inserted, updated, unchanged or removed action.
- Adopted existing record, restored key and changed-source indicators.
- Exact before/after values and the selected target's current version fingerprint.

The complete JSON uses tagged values for precise types. For example, ["integer","9007199254740993"] is an exact integer, ["decimal","12.34000001"] is an exact decimal, ["null"] is explicit null, and ["datetime","2026-10-12T08:00:00.000000000Z"] is a UTC instant. The original unmodified source JSON is retained beside those mapped values.

Review all changes through these files or embed Preview.each_entry in the application's existing review screen. The neutral JSON/CSV surfaces carry the full dataset; the printed summary provides navigation and the selected hash. No preview is committed by creating or exporting it.

## Apply that selected preview

Use a persistent operation key from the application's own import/job record. Preserve that exact key and preview hash when a job retries.

~~~sh
bin/rails runner "$dataset_package/examples/rails_dataset/commission.rb" commit -- \
  --tenant account-42 --stream merchant-catalog \
  --delivery /absolute/private/received-dataset \
  --manifest-sha256 ACTUAL_DATASET_CUSTOMER_MANIFEST_SHA256 \
  --mapping /absolute/application/config/dataset-catalog-mapping.json \
  --operation catalog-edition-2026-10-12 \
  --preview-sha256 ACTUAL_COMPLETE_PREVIEW_SHA256 \
  --out /absolute/application/tmp/dataset-review
~~~

The importer locks the stream, rebuilds the complete current preview and compares it to the selected hash. It then saves the actual application models using their normal validations and callbacks, verifies the stored mapped values and scope, and commits the target updates plus complete edition history together. A changed target, changed stream revision or changed source/mapping produces a fresh-preview requirement before any edition is applied. Database/model validation failures roll back the whole transaction.

If a process exits after the database commit but before exporting its receipt, the same command with the original operation and preview returns that already committed edition and recreates its complete receipt export. Using that operation key for another source, mapping or preview is rejected.

The importer owns its database transaction boundary. Call it outside another open application transaction. Use database-side work or the application's after_commit/outbox arrangement for external effects in model callbacks. Active Record documents [transaction scope and callback behavior](https://api.rubyonrails.org/v7.1.0/classes/ActiveRecord/Transactions/ClassMethods.html) and [row locking with with_lock](https://api.rubyonrails.org/v7.1.0/classes/ActiveRecord/Locking/Pessimistic.html).

## Use the actual application job

The provided ImportDatasetJob consumes an already received complete packet and selected application preview. Resolve tenant identity and paths within the authenticated application, then enqueue the stable values:

~~~ruby
Starforge::DatasetExample::ImportDatasetJob.perform_later(
  stream_id: stream.id,
  tenant_key: current_account.dataset_tenant_key,
  delivery_directory: import_record.received_directory,
  manifest_sha256: import_record.dataset_manifest_sha256,
  mapping_path: Rails.root.join("config", "dataset-catalog-mapping.json").to_s,
  operation_key: import_record.operation_key,
  preview_sha256: import_record.selected_preview_sha256,
  receipt_path: import_record.receipt_path
)
~~~

Require the delivered job from an application initializer, for example require "/absolute/customer-package/examples/rails_dataset/import_dataset_job". To move it into the application's normal autoload paths, move its model classes with it and update the relative require to their actual location. The importer takes those classes explicitly:

~~~ruby
importer = Starforge::RailsDataset.new(
  delivery: delivery,
  scope: current_account.catalog_records,
  stream: stream,
  models: {edition: DatasetEdition, row: DatasetRow, entry: DatasetEntry},
  mapping: mapping
)
preview = importer.preview
begin
  File.open(review_path, "wb") { |io| preview.write_json(io) }
  selected_hash = preview.sha256
ensure
  preview.close
end
# Persist selected_hash with the application review decision, then use it:
receipt = importer.import!(
  operation_key: import_record.operation_key,
  expected_preview_sha256: import_record.selected_preview_sha256
)
~~~

The source key is resolved against the real scoped target relation. An existing matching record can be adopted once; a record already managed by a different stream is rejected. If a tracked target has moved outside the authorized scope, the application must resolve that relationship before applying another edition. All new records inherit the fixed values from the original scope.

## Reopen a committed edition and continue revisions

The status command reads the current stream and complete active/removed key counts:

~~~sh
bin/rails runner "$dataset_package/examples/rails_dataset/commission.rb" status -- \
  --tenant account-42 --stream merchant-catalog
~~~

The receipt command exports every retained entry from an existing operation, including original source JSON and exact before/after values:

~~~sh
bin/rails runner "$dataset_package/examples/rails_dataset/commission.rb" receipt -- \
  --tenant account-42 --stream merchant-catalog \
  --delivery /absolute/private/received-dataset \
  --manifest-sha256 ACTUAL_DATASET_CUSTOMER_MANIFEST_SHA256 \
  --mapping /absolute/application/config/dataset-catalog-mapping.json \
  --operation catalog-edition-2026-10-12 \
  --out /absolute/application/tmp/dataset-review
~~~

Reopen can use a current complete packet belonging to the same bound stream while exporting an earlier operation's saved source rows. The exporter checks every retained row hash, complete entry count and edition digest. All output writes are streamed into a private temporary file; an interrupted export can be repeated, and an existing path is accepted only when its full bytes match.

For the next original dataset edition, retain the same stream and stable key mapping, receive its complete packet, create a new application operation key, preview its entire diff and commit that selected preview. The existing target identities, source history and application records advance together.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# MIT. Complete private SF88 session archives; the original Node buyer owns all semantics.
from __future__ import annotations
import contextlib, ctypes, errno, fcntl, hashlib, json, os, re, stat, sys, uuid, zipfile
from pathlib import Path

SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.sf88.dataset-session-archive.v1"
LOCATION = ".sf88-location.json"
HISTORY = ".sf88-portable-history"
MANIFEST = "SF88_SESSION.json"
MAX_MANIFEST = 32 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_FILE = 256 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_TOTAL = 16 * 1024**3
MAX_FILES = 250000
HASH = re.compile(r"^[a-f0-9]{64}$")
OPERATION = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$")
BLOCK = 1024 * 1024

class Failure(Exception):
    def __init__(self, code):
        super().__init__(code)
        self.code = code

def need(value, code):
    if not value:
        raise Failure(code)

def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

def encoded(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n").encode("utf-8")

def parse(raw):
    def pairs(items):
        result = {}
        for key, value in items:
            need(key not in result, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_DUPLICATE_JSON_KEY")
            result[key] = value
        return result
    try:
        return json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=pairs,
                          parse_constant=lambda value: (_ for _ in ()).throw(Failure("DATASET_ARCHIVE_JSON_INVALID")))
    except (UnicodeError, ValueError, TypeError):
        raise Failure("DATASET_ARCHIVE_JSON_INVALID") from None

def absolute(value):
    need(isinstance(value, str) and "\0" not in value and os.path.isabs(value)
         and os.path.normpath(value) == value, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_ABSOLUTE_PATH_REQUIRED")
    return Path(value)

def within(root, path):
    return path == root or root in path.parents

def private_root(path):
    path = absolute(str(path))
    item = path.lstat()
    need(stat.S_ISDIR(item.st_mode) and not stat.S_ISLNK(item.st_mode)
         and path.resolve() == path and item.st_uid == os.getuid()
         and not item.st_mode & 0o077, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_PRIVATE_DIRECTORY_REQUIRED")
    return item

def ordinary(path, directory=False):
    info = path.lstat()
    need(not stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode) and
         (stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) if directory else stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode))
         and info.st_uid == os.getuid() and not info.st_mode & 0o7000,
         "DATASET_ARCHIVE_SOURCE_TYPE_OR_OWNER")
    if not directory:
        need(info.st_nlink == 1, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_PRIVATE_SOURCE_REQUIRED")
    return info

def identity(info):
    return (info.st_dev, info.st_ino, info.st_mode, info.st_size, info.st_mtime_ns, info.st_ctime_ns)

def sync_directory(path):
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)

def read(path, maximum=MAX_MANIFEST, private=True):
    if private:
        private_root(path.parent)
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        info = os.fstat(fd)
        need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1 and
             info.st_uid == os.getuid() and info.st_size <= maximum and
             (not private or not info.st_mode & 0o077), "DATASET_ARCHIVE_FILE_INVALID")
        chunks, size = [], 0
        while True:
            raw = os.read(fd, min(BLOCK, maximum + 1 - size))
            if not raw:
                break
            chunks.append(raw)
            size += len(raw)
            need(size <= maximum, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_FILE_LIMIT")
        need(identity(info) == identity(os.fstat(fd)) == identity(path.lstat()),
             "DATASET_ARCHIVE_SOURCE_CHANGED")
        return b"".join(chunks)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)

def file_digest(path, maximum=MAX_FILE, expected=None):
    info = ordinary(path)
    need(info.st_size <= maximum, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_FILE_LIMIT")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    h, size = hashlib.sha256(), 0
    try:
        need(identity(info) == identity(os.fstat(fd)), "DATASET_ARCHIVE_SOURCE_CHANGED")
        while True:
            raw = os.read(fd, BLOCK)
            if not raw:
                break
            size += len(raw)
            need(size <= maximum, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_FILE_LIMIT")
            h.update(raw)
        need(identity(info) == identity(os.fstat(fd)) == identity(path.lstat()),
             "DATASET_ARCHIVE_SOURCE_CHANGED")
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    result = {"bytes": size, "sha256": h.hexdigest(), "mode": stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)}
    if expected is not None:
        need(all(result[key] == expected[key] for key in result), "DATASET_ARCHIVE_MEMBER_CHANGED")
    return result, identity(info)

def replace_json(path, value):
    raw = encoded(value)
    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + ".next")
    fd = os.open(temporary, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        info = os.fstat(fd)
        need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1 and
             info.st_uid == os.getuid() and not info.st_mode & 0o077, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_CONTROL_CHANGED")
        os.ftruncate(fd, 0)
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb", closefd=False) as stream:
            stream.write(raw)
            stream.flush()
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    os.replace(temporary, path)
    sync_directory(path.parent)

def create_exact(path, raw, mode=0o600, temporary_directory=None):
    if path.exists():
        need(read(path, max(MAX_MANIFEST, len(raw))) == raw, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_CONTROL_CHANGED")
        return
    # A complete control/member file becomes visible atomically. Partial writes
    # remain in this same operation's separate private control directory.
    directory = temporary_directory or path.parent
    temporary = directory / ("create-" + sha(str(path).encode()) + ".partial")
    fd = os.open(temporary, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        info = os.fstat(fd)
        need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1 and info.st_uid == os.getuid()
             and not info.st_mode & 0o077, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_CONTROL_CHANGED")
        os.ftruncate(fd, 0)
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb", closefd=False) as stream:
            stream.write(raw)
            stream.flush()
        os.fchmod(fd, mode)
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    try:
        publish_absent(temporary, path)
    except FileExistsError:
        need(read(path, max(MAX_MANIFEST, len(raw))) == raw, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_CONTROL_CHANGED")


def publish_absent(source, destination):
    # Publish without replacing even an empty directory created by another owner.
    library = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
    function = getattr(library, "renameat2", None)
    need(function is not None, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_NOREPLACE_REQUIRED")
    function.argtypes = (ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_uint)
    function.restype = ctypes.c_int
    if function(-100, os.fsencode(source), -100, os.fsencode(destination), 1):
        value = ctypes.get_errno()
        if value == errno.EEXIST:
            raise FileExistsError(value, os.strerror(value), str(destination))
        raise OSError(value, os.strerror(value))
    sync_directory(destination.parent)
    if source.parent != destination.parent:
        sync_directory(source.parent)

@contextlib.contextmanager
def control_lease(directory):
    directory.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
    private_root(directory)
    fd = os.open(directory / "lease.lock", os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        info = os.fstat(fd)
        need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1 and
             info.st_uid == os.getuid() and not info.st_mode & 0o077, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_CONTROL_CHANGED")
        try:
            fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        except BlockingIOError:
            raise Failure("DATASET_ARCHIVE_OPERATION_RUNNING") from None
        yield
    finally:
        os.close(fd)

def relpath(value, directory=False):
    need(isinstance(value, str) and "\\" not in value and "\0" not in value
         and len(value.encode("utf-8")) <= 4096, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_MEMBER_PATH")
    if directory and value == "":
        return value
    need(value and not value.startswith("/") and
         all(part not in ("", ".", "..") for part in value.split("/"))
         and not any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in value),
         "DATASET_ARCHIVE_MEMBER_PATH")
    return value

def inventory(root, *, exclude=True):
    files, directories, identities = [], [], {}
    stack = [root]
    while stack:
        directory = stack.pop()
        info = ordinary(directory, True)
        relative = directory.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        if relative == ".":
            relative = ""
        directories.append({"path": relative, "mode": stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)})
        identities[relative + "/"] = identity(info)
        for item in sorted(directory.iterdir(), key=lambda path: path.name, reverse=True):
            key = item.relative_to(root).as_posix()
            if exclude and key in ("run.lock", LOCATION):
                continue
            relpath(key)
            info = item.lstat()
            if stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) and not stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode):
                stack.append(item)
            else:
                body, inode = file_digest(item)
                files.append({"path": key, **body})
                identities[key] = inode
            need(len(files) + len(directories) <= MAX_FILES, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_MEMBER_LIMIT")
    files.sort(key=lambda item: item["path"])
    directories.sort(key=lambda item: item["path"])
    return files, directories, identities

@contextlib.contextmanager
def source_wire_leases(root):
    held = []
    try:
        for directory, names, files in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
            for name in names:
                need(not Path(directory, name).is_symlink(), "DATASET_ARCHIVE_SOURCE_TYPE_OR_OWNER")
            if "active.lock" not in files:
                continue
            path = Path(directory, "active.lock")
            info = ordinary(path)
            fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDWR | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
            try:
                need(identity(info) == identity(os.fstat(fd)), "DATASET_ARCHIVE_SOURCE_CHANGED")
                fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
            except BaseException:
                os.close(fd)
                raise
            held.append(fd)
        yield
    except BlockingIOError:
        raise Failure("DATASET_ARCHIVE_ORIGINAL_WIRE_ACTIVE") from None
    finally:
        for fd in held:
            os.close(fd)

def validate_manifest(value, maximum):
    need(isinstance(value, dict) and value.get("schema") == SCHEMA and
         OPERATION.fullmatch(value.get("operation", "")) and
         HASH.fullmatch(value.get("sessionSha256", "")) and
         HASH.fullmatch(value.get("configurationSha256", "")),
         "DATASET_ARCHIVE_MANIFEST_INVALID")
    absolute(value.get("sourceDirectory"))
    need(isinstance(value.get("files"), list) and isinstance(value.get("directories"), list)
         and 1 <= len(value["files"]) <= MAX_FILES and
         1 <= len(value["directories"]) <= MAX_FILES and
         len(value["files"]) + len(value["directories"]) <= MAX_FILES,
         "DATASET_ARCHIVE_MEMBER_LIMIT")
    names, total = set(), 0
    directories = set()
    for item in value["directories"]:
        need(isinstance(item, dict) and set(item) == {"path", "mode"}, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_DIRECTORY_INVALID")
        key = relpath(item["path"], True)
        need(key not in names and type(item["mode"]) is int and
             0 <= item["mode"] <= 0o777 and item["mode"] & 0o500 == 0o500,
             "DATASET_ARCHIVE_DIRECTORY_INVALID")
        names.add(key)
        directories.add(key)
    need("" in directories and not next(item for item in value["directories"] if item["path"] == "")["mode"] & 0o077,
         "DATASET_ARCHIVE_PRIVATE_DIRECTORY_REQUIRED")
    for item in value["files"]:
        need(isinstance(item, dict) and set(item) == {"path", "mode", "bytes", "sha256"},
             "DATASET_ARCHIVE_MEMBER_INVALID")
        key = relpath(item["path"])
        need(key not in names and key not in ("run.lock", LOCATION) and
             type(item["mode"]) is int and 0 <= item["mode"] <= 0o777 and item["mode"] & 0o400 and
             type(item["bytes"]) is int and 0 <= item["bytes"] <= MAX_FILE and
             HASH.fullmatch(item["sha256"] or ""), "DATASET_ARCHIVE_MEMBER_INVALID")
        names.add(key)
        total += item["bytes"]
        need(total <= maximum, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_TOTAL_LIMIT")
    for key in names:
        if key:
            parent = key.rpartition("/")[0]
            need(parent in directories, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_PARENT_MISSING")
    need(sum(item["path"] == "session.json" for item in value["files"]) == 1 and
         next(item for item in value["files"] if item["path"] == "session.json")["sha256"] == value["sessionSha256"]
         and value.get("bytes") == total and
         isinstance(value.get("inspection"), dict), "DATASET_ARCHIVE_MANIFEST_INVALID")
    return value

def checked_archive(path, expected, maximum, *, verify=True):
    private_root(path.parent)
    info = ordinary(path)
    need(not info.st_mode & 0o077 and info.st_size <= maximum + MAX_MANIFEST + MAX_FILES * 1024,
         "DATASET_ARCHIVE_PRIVATE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED")
    actual, _ = file_digest(path, maximum + MAX_MANIFEST + MAX_FILES * 1024)
    need(expected is None or actual["sha256"] == expected, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_DIGEST_MISMATCH")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
        entries = archive.infolist()
        need(len(entries) <= MAX_FILES + 2 and len({entry.filename for entry in entries}) == len(entries),
             "DATASET_ARCHIVE_DUPLICATE_OR_EXCESS_MEMBER")
        try:
            entry = archive.getinfo(MANIFEST)
        except KeyError:
            raise Failure("DATASET_ARCHIVE_MANIFEST_MISSING") from None
        need(entry.file_size <= MAX_MANIFEST, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_MANIFEST_LIMIT")
        manifest_raw = archive.read(entry)
        manifest = validate_manifest(parse(manifest_raw), maximum)
        expected_names = {MANIFEST}
        expected_names.update("session/" + item["path"] + ("/" if item["path"] else "")
                              for item in manifest["directories"])
        expected_names.update("session/" + item["path"] for item in manifest["files"])
        need({entry.filename for entry in entries} == expected_names, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_CLOSURE_MISMATCH")
        files = {item["path"]: item for item in manifest["files"]}
        dirs = {item["path"]: item for item in manifest["directories"]}
        for entry in entries:
            need(not entry.flag_bits & 1 and entry.compress_type in (zipfile.ZIP_STORED, zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED),
                 "DATASET_ARCHIVE_ENCODING_UNSUPPORTED")
            mode = entry.external_attr >> 16
            if entry.filename == MANIFEST:
                need(not entry.is_dir() and stat.S_ISREG(mode), "DATASET_ARCHIVE_MEMBER_INVALID")
                continue
            key = entry.filename[len("session/"):]
            directory = entry.is_dir()
            key = key[:-1] if directory and key else key
            item = dirs.get(key) if directory else files.get(key)
            need(item is not None and stat.S_IMODE(mode) == item["mode"] and
                 (stat.S_ISDIR(mode) if directory else stat.S_ISREG(mode)) and
                 entry.file_size == (0 if directory else item["bytes"]), "DATASET_ARCHIVE_MEMBER_INVALID")
            if verify and not directory:
                h, size = hashlib.sha256(), 0
                with archive.open(entry) as stream:
                    while True:
                        raw = stream.read(BLOCK)
                        if not raw:
                            break
                        size += len(raw)
                        need(size <= item["bytes"], "DATASET_ARCHIVE_MEMBER_LIMIT")
                        h.update(raw)
                need(size == item["bytes"] and h.hexdigest() == item["sha256"],
                     "DATASET_ARCHIVE_MEMBER_CHANGED")
        session = parse(archive.read("session/session.json"))
        need(session.get("directory") == manifest["sourceDirectory"] and
             session.get("configurationSha256") == manifest["configurationSha256"],
             "DATASET_ARCHIVE_SESSION_CHANGED")
    need(identity(info) == identity(path.lstat()), "DATASET_ARCHIVE_SOURCE_CHANGED")
    return {"archive": str(path), "sha256": actual["sha256"], "bytes": actual["bytes"],
            "manifestSha256": sha(manifest_raw), "manifest": manifest}, manifest_raw

def zip_info(name, mode, directory=False):
    entry = zipfile.ZipInfo(name, (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
    entry.create_system = 3
    entry.external_attr = ((stat.S_IFDIR if directory else stat.S_IFREG) | mode) << 16
    if directory:
        entry.external_attr |= 0x10
    entry.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
    return entry

def summary(package, **fields):
    manifest = package["manifest"]
    return {"schema": SCHEMA, "archive": package["archive"], "archiveSha256": package["sha256"],
            "archiveBytes": package["bytes"], "manifestSha256": package["manifestSha256"],
            "sourceDirectory": manifest["sourceDirectory"], "sessionSha256": manifest["sessionSha256"],
            "configurationSha256": manifest["configurationSha256"],
            "files": len(manifest["files"]), "directories": len(manifest["directories"]),
            "sourceBytes": manifest["bytes"], "inspection": manifest["inspection"], **fields}

def export_session(request):
    source, destination = absolute(request["directory"]), absolute(request["archive"])
    private_root(source)
    private_root(destination.parent)
    need(not within(source, destination) and not within(destination, source),
         "DATASET_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_OVERLAPS_SOURCE")
    operation = request["operation"]
    need(OPERATION.fullmatch(operation), "DATASET_ARCHIVE_OPERATION_REQUIRED")
    control = destination.parent / (".sf88-export-" + sha(str(destination).encode())[:24])
    maximum = request["maxBytes"]
    with control_lease(control), source_wire_leases(source):
        intent_path, manifest_path = control / "intent.json", control / "manifest.json"
        binding = {"schema": SCHEMA + ".export", "operation": operation, "source": str(source),
                   "archive": str(destination), "sourceDirectory": request["sourceDirectory"],
                   "configurationSha256": request["configurationSha256"],
                   "sessionSha256": sha(read(source / "session.json", 262144))}
        if intent_path.exists():
            need(parse(read(intent_path)) == binding, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_EXPORT_SELECTION_CHANGED")
        else:
            need(not destination.exists(), "DATASET_ARCHIVE_DESTINATION_EXISTS")
            create_exact(intent_path, encoded(binding))
        if destination.exists():
            package, raw = checked_archive(destination, None, maximum)
            need(read(manifest_path) == raw, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_EXPORT_CHANGED")
            return summary(package, operation=operation, state="EXPORTED", reused=True)
        if manifest_path.exists():
            manifest_raw = read(manifest_path)
            manifest = validate_manifest(parse(manifest_raw), maximum)
            files, directories, before = inventory(source)
            need(files == manifest["files"] and directories == manifest["directories"],
                 "DATASET_ARCHIVE_SOURCE_CHANGED")
        else:
            files, directories, before = inventory(source)
            manifest = validate_manifest({"schema": SCHEMA, "operation": operation,
                "sourceDirectory": request["sourceDirectory"], "sessionSha256": binding["sessionSha256"],
                "configurationSha256": request["configurationSha256"], "files": files,
                "directories": directories, "bytes": sum(item["bytes"] for item in files),
                "inspection": request["inspection"]}, maximum)
            manifest_raw = encoded(manifest)
            need(len(manifest_raw) <= MAX_MANIFEST, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_MANIFEST_LIMIT")
            create_exact(manifest_path, manifest_raw)
        temporary = control / "archive.partial"
        fd = os.open(temporary, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
        try:
            info = os.fstat(fd)
            need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1 and
                 info.st_uid == os.getuid() and not info.st_mode & 0o077, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_CONTROL_CHANGED")
            os.ftruncate(fd, 0)
            with os.fdopen(fd, "w+b", closefd=False) as output:
                with zipfile.ZipFile(output, "w", allowZip64=True, compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,
                                     compresslevel=6) as archive:
                    archive.writestr(zip_info(MANIFEST, 0o600), manifest_raw)
                    for item in directories:
                        archive.writestr(zip_info("session/" + item["path"] + ("/" if item["path"] else ""),
                                                  item["mode"], True), b"")
                    for item in files:
                        path = source / item["path"]
                        need(identity(ordinary(path)) == before[item["path"]], "DATASET_ARCHIVE_SOURCE_CHANGED")
                        source_fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
                        try:
                            need(identity(os.fstat(source_fd)) == before[item["path"]], "DATASET_ARCHIVE_SOURCE_CHANGED")
                            h, size = hashlib.sha256(), 0
                            with archive.open(zip_info("session/" + item["path"], item["mode"]), "w",
                                              force_zip64=True) as member:
                                while True:
                                    block = os.read(source_fd, BLOCK)
                                    if not block:
                                        break
                                    size += len(block)
                                    need(size <= item["bytes"], "DATASET_ARCHIVE_SOURCE_CHANGED")
                                    h.update(block)
                                    member.write(block)
                            need(size == item["bytes"] and h.hexdigest() == item["sha256"]
                                 and identity(os.fstat(source_fd)) == before[item["path"]],
                                 "DATASET_ARCHIVE_SOURCE_CHANGED")
                        finally:
                            os.close(source_fd)
                output.flush()
            os.fsync(fd)
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
        after_files, after_dirs, after = inventory(source)
        need(files == after_files and directories == after_dirs and before == after,
             "DATASET_ARCHIVE_SOURCE_CHANGED")
        package, raw = checked_archive(temporary, None, maximum)
        need(raw == manifest_raw, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_EXPORT_CHANGED")
        publish_absent(temporary, destination)
        package["archive"] = str(destination)
        return summary(package, operation=operation, state="EXPORTED", reused=False)

def selected_tree(stage, manifest, archive_sha, *, complete=False, allow_run_lock=False):
    wanted_files = {item["path"]: item for item in manifest["files"]}
    wanted_dirs = {item["path"]: item for item in manifest["directories"]}
    found = set()
    for directory, dirs, files in os.walk(stage, followlinks=False):
        root = Path(directory)
        key = root.relative_to(stage).as_posix()
        key = "" if key == "." else key
        need(key in wanted_dirs or key == HISTORY, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_UNEXPECTED_STAGE_MEMBER")
        info = ordinary(root, True)
        # A stage uses writable original-owner directories until final publication.
        for name in dirs:
            ordinary(root / name, True)
        for name in files:
            path = root / name
            key = path.relative_to(stage).as_posix()
            if key == "run.lock" and allow_run_lock:
                lease = ordinary(path)
                need(lease.st_size <= 4096 and not lease.st_mode & 0o077,
                     "DATASET_ARCHIVE_NATIVE_LEASE_INVALID")
                continue
            if key == LOCATION or key == HISTORY + "/" + archive_sha + ".json":
                continue
            need(key in wanted_files, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_UNEXPECTED_STAGE_MEMBER")
            file_digest(path, expected=wanted_files[key])
            found.add(key)
    if complete:
        need(found == set(wanted_files), "DATASET_ARCHIVE_STAGE_INCOMPLETE")

def receive_session(request, publish=False):
    archive, destination = absolute(request["archive"]), absolute(request["destination"])
    operation = request["operation"]
    need(OPERATION.fullmatch(operation) and HASH.fullmatch(request.get("expectedSha256", "")),
         "DATASET_ARCHIVE_EXACT_SOURCE_REQUIRED")
    private_root(destination.parent)
    package, manifest_raw = checked_archive(archive, request["expectedSha256"], request["maxBytes"], verify=not publish)
    manifest = package["manifest"]
    logical = absolute(manifest["sourceDirectory"])
    need(destination == logical or not within(destination, logical) and not within(logical, destination),
         "DATASET_LOCATION_ROOTS_OVERLAP")
    need(not within(destination, archive), "DATASET_ARCHIVE_INPUT_OVERLAPS_DESTINATION")
    control = destination.parent / (".sf88-receive-" + sha(str(destination).encode())[:24])
    binding = receive_binding(request, package, destination)
    with control_lease(control):
        intent = control / "intent.json"
        if intent.exists():
            need(parse(read(intent)) == binding, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_RECEIVE_SELECTION_CHANGED")
        else:
            need(not destination.exists(), "DATASET_ARCHIVE_DESTINATION_EXISTS")
            create_exact(intent, encoded(binding))
        record_path = control / "stage.json"
        record = parse(read(record_path)) if record_path.exists() else None
        if record is not None:
            need(isinstance(record, dict) and all(record.get(key) == value for key, value in binding.items()),
                 "DATASET_ARCHIVE_STAGE_SELECTION_CHANGED")
            stage = absolute(record["stage"])
            need(stage.parent == control and re.fullmatch(r"stage-[a-f0-9]{32}", stage.name),
                 "DATASET_ARCHIVE_STAGE_SELECTION_CHANGED")
        else:
            stage = control / ("stage-" + uuid.uuid4().hex)
        location_raw = encoded(stage_location(package, operation))
        if destination.exists():
            info = private_root(destination)
            need(record is not None and record["device"] == info.st_dev and record["inode"] == info.st_ino
                 and read(destination / LOCATION, 16384) == location_raw
                 and sha(read(destination / "session.json", 262144)) == manifest["sessionSha256"],
                 "DATASET_ARCHIVE_DESTINATION_CHANGED")
            record["state"] = "RECEIVED"
            replace_json(record_path, record)
            return summary(package, operation=operation, directory=str(destination), state="RECEIVED", reused=True)
        if record is None:
            stage.mkdir(mode=0o700)
            sync_directory(control)
            info = private_root(stage)
            record = {**binding, "stage": str(stage), "device": info.st_dev,
                      "inode": info.st_ino, "state": "RECEIVING"}
            create_exact(record_path, encoded(record))
        info = ordinary(stage, True)
        need(info.st_dev == record["device"] and info.st_ino == record["inode"],
             "DATASET_ARCHIVE_STAGE_IDENTITY_CHANGED")
        # Only recorded own directories regain write permission for continuation.
        for item in sorted(manifest["directories"], key=lambda item: item["path"].count("/")):
            target = stage / item["path"]
            if target.exists():
                ordinary(target, True)
                os.chmod(target, item["mode"] | 0o700)
            else:
                target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
                sync_directory(target.parent)
        selected_tree(stage, manifest, package["sha256"], allow_run_lock=not publish)
        if not publish:
            with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as source:
                for item in manifest["files"]:
                    target = stage / item["path"]
                    if target.exists():
                        file_digest(target, expected=item)
                        continue
                    temporary = control / ("member-" + sha(item["path"].encode()) + ".partial")
                    fd = os.open(temporary, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
                    try:
                        info = os.fstat(fd)
                        need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1 and info.st_uid == os.getuid(),
                             "DATASET_ARCHIVE_CONTROL_CHANGED")
                        os.ftruncate(fd, 0)
                        h, size = hashlib.sha256(), 0
                        with source.open("session/" + item["path"]) as input_:
                            with os.fdopen(fd, "wb", closefd=False) as output:
                                while True:
                                    raw = input_.read(BLOCK)
                                    if not raw:
                                        break
                                    size += len(raw)
                                    need(size <= item["bytes"], "DATASET_ARCHIVE_MEMBER_LIMIT")
                                    h.update(raw)
                                    output.write(raw)
                                output.flush()
                        need(size == item["bytes"] and h.hexdigest() == item["sha256"],
                             "DATASET_ARCHIVE_MEMBER_CHANGED")
                        os.fchmod(fd, item["mode"])
                        os.fsync(fd)
                    finally:
                        os.close(fd)
                    publish_absent(temporary, target)
            history = stage / HISTORY
            history.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
            private_root(history)
            create_exact(history / (package["sha256"] + ".json"), manifest_raw, temporary_directory=control)
            create_exact(stage / LOCATION, location_raw, temporary_directory=control)
            selected_tree(stage, manifest, package["sha256"], complete=True, allow_run_lock=True)
            record["state"] = "PREPARED"
            replace_json(record_path, record)
            return summary(package, operation=operation, directory=str(stage), destination=str(destination),
                           state="PREPARED", reused=False)
        need(record["state"] in ("PREPARED", "PUBLISHING"), "DATASET_ARCHIVE_RECEIVE_PREPARATION_REQUIRED")
        need(read(stage / LOCATION, 16384) == location_raw and
             read(stage / HISTORY / (package["sha256"] + ".json")) == manifest_raw,
             "DATASET_ARCHIVE_CONTROL_CHANGED")
        selected_tree(stage, manifest, package["sha256"], complete=True)
        record["state"] = "PUBLISHING"
        replace_json(record_path, record)
        for item in sorted(manifest["directories"], key=lambda item: item["path"].count("/"), reverse=True):
            os.chmod(stage / item["path"], item["mode"])
        publish_absent(stage, destination)
        record["state"] = "RECEIVED"
        replace_json(record_path, record)
        return summary(package, operation=operation, directory=str(destination), state="RECEIVED", reused=False)

def main():
    request = parse(sys.stdin.buffer.read(MAX_MANIFEST + 1))
    need(isinstance(request, dict), "DATASET_ARCHIVE_REQUEST_REQUIRED")
    maximum = request.get("maxBytes", 2 * 1024**3)
    need(type(maximum) is int and 1 <= maximum <= MAX_TOTAL, "DATASET_ARCHIVE_TOTAL_LIMIT")
    request["maxBytes"] = maximum
    action = request.get("action")
    if action == "inspect":
        expected = request.get("expectedSha256")
        need(expected is None or HASH.fullmatch(expected), "DATASET_ARCHIVE_DIGEST_REQUIRED")
        package, _ = checked_archive(absolute(request["archive"]), expected, maximum)
        return summary(package, state="INSPECTED", operation=package["manifest"]["operation"])
    if action == "export":
        return export_session(request)
    if action in ("receive", "publish"):
        return receive_session(request, action == "publish")
    raise Failure("DATASET_ARCHIVE_ACTION_REQUIRED")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        result = main()
        sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
    except Exception as error:
        code = error.code if isinstance(error, Failure) else (
            "DATASET_ARCHIVE_IO_" + errno.errorcode.get(error.errno, "FAILED")
            if isinstance(error, OSError) else "DATASET_ARCHIVE_INVALID")
        sys.stdout.write(json.dumps({"schema": SCHEMA, "state": "ERROR", "code": code}) + "\n")
        sys.exit(75 if code == "DATASET_ARCHIVE_OPERATION_RUNNING" else 2)

require_relative "dataset_delivery"

module Starforge
  class NativeDatasetDelivery < DatasetDelivery
    SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.ruby-native-dataset-delivery.v1"
    SOURCE_SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.ruby-native-dataset-source.v1"
    SELECTION_SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.ruby-native-dataset-selection.v1"
    RECEIPT_SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.finalized-dataset-receiving.v1"
    MAX_PAGE = 2_097_152 + 4096
    MAX_PAGES = 4096
    METADATA = %w[source.json selection.json native-receiving.json].freeze
    OUTPUTS = %w[manifest.json dataset.jsonl dataset.csv review.html].freeze
    attr_reader :native_receipt

    def self.file_limit(name)
      return MAX_PAGE if /\Apages\/[0-9]{5}\.json\z/.match?(name.to_s)
      return 4096 if name == "session.json"
      return 2_097_152 if name == "semantics.json"
      return 4_194_304 if name == "manifest.json"
      return 16_777_216 if name == "native-receiving.json"
      return 1_048_576 if %w[source.json selection.json].include?(name)
      return MAX_FILE if %w[dataset.jsonl dataset.csv review.html].include?(name)
      raise Error, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_FILE_NAME_INVALID"
    end

    def self.check_descriptor(name, descriptor)
      Files.need(descriptor.is_a?(Hash) && descriptor["bytes"].is_a?(Integer) &&
        descriptor["bytes"].between?(0,file_limit(name)) && HASH.match?(descriptor["sha256"].to_s),
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_FILE_DESCRIPTOR_INVALID")
      descriptor
    end

    # Provider identity is read from the original producer's dictionary schema.
    # Attribution and definition/capture hashes remain on their original edition.
    def self.provider_identity(semantics)
      return nil if semantics.nil?
      Files.need(semantics.is_a?(Hash) && semantics["source"].is_a?(Hash),
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SEMANTICS_INVALID")
      original = semantics.fetch("source")
      value = case semantics["schema"]
      when "stellar-forge.ckan-semantics.v1"
        {"provider"=>"ckan","catalog_origin"=>original["catalogOrigin"],
         "package_id"=>original["packageId"],"resource_id"=>original["resourceId"]}
      when "stellar-forge.odata-semantics.v1"
        Files.need(original["provider"] == "odata4", "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PROVIDER_CHANGED")
        {"provider"=>"odata4","service_url"=>original["serviceUrl"],
         "entity_container"=>original["entityContainer"],"entity_set"=>original["entitySet"]}
      when "stellar-forge.superset-semantics.v1"
        return superset_provider_identity(semantics)
      when "stellar-forge.directus-semantics.v1"
        return directus_provider_identity(semantics)
      else
        raise Error, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SEMANTICS_INVALID"
      end
      Files.need(value.values.all? { |item| item.is_a?(String) && !item.empty? &&
        item.valid_encoding? && item.bytesize <= 16_384 }, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PROVIDER_CHANGED")
      value
    end

    # The producer already normalizes this URL. Retain its complete reverse-proxy
    # path and reject a different URL representation instead of silently changing
    # a saved resource's logical membership.
    def self.provider_base(value)
      Files.need(value.is_a?(String) && !value.empty? && value.valid_encoding? &&
        value.bytesize <= 16_384, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PROVIDER_CHANGED")
      uri = URI.parse(value)
      Files.need(uri.is_a?(URI::HTTP) && %w[http https].include?(uri.scheme) &&
        uri.host.is_a?(String) && !uri.host.empty? && uri.userinfo.nil? &&
        uri.query.nil? && uri.fragment.nil? && uri.path.end_with?("/") &&
        uri.normalize.to_s == value, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PROVIDER_CHANGED")
      value
    rescue URI::InvalidURIError
      raise Error, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PROVIDER_CHANGED"
    end

    def self.provider_text(value)
      Files.need(value.is_a?(String) && !value.empty? && value.valid_encoding? &&
        value.bytesize <= 16_384, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PROVIDER_CHANGED")
      value
    end

    def self.provider_integer(value, minimum: 0)
      Files.need(value.is_a?(Integer) && value.between?(minimum,9_007_199_254_740_991),
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PROVIDER_CHANGED")
      value
    end

    def self.superset_provider_identity(semantics)
      source,query = semantics.fetch("source"),semantics["query"]
      Files.need(source["provider"] == "apache-superset" && source["protocolVersion"] == "6.1" &&
        HASH.match?(source["queryContextSha256"].to_s) &&
        HASH.match?(source["principalSha256"].to_s) && query.is_a?(Hash) &&
        query["savedContextSha256"] == source["queryContextSha256"],
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PROVIDER_CHANGED")
      chart_uuid = source["chartUuid"]
      provider_text(chart_uuid) unless chart_uuid.nil?
      row_limit = query["rowLimit"]
      provider_integer(row_limit) unless row_limit.nil?
      {"provider"=>"apache-superset","protocol_version"=>source["protocolVersion"],
       "server_url"=>provider_base(source["baseUrl"]),
       "chart_id"=>provider_integer(source["chartId"],minimum: 1),"chart_uuid"=>chart_uuid,
       "query_ordinal"=>provider_integer(source["queryOrdinal"]),
       "query_context_sha256"=>source["queryContextSha256"],
       "principal_sha256"=>source["principalSha256"],
       "row_limit"=>row_limit,"row_offset"=>provider_integer(query["rowOffset"])}
    end

    def self.directus_provider_identity(semantics)
      source = semantics.fetch("source")
      query,principal = source["query"],source["principal"]
      Files.need(source["provider"] == "directus" && source["protocolVersion"] == "12.5" &&
        query.is_a?(Hash) && query["fields"].is_a?(Array) && query["sort"].is_a?(Array) &&
        principal.is_a?(Hash), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_PROVIDER_CHANGED")
      provider_text(principal["id"])
      {"provider"=>"directus","protocol_version"=>source["protocolVersion"],
       "server_url"=>provider_base(source["baseUrl"]),
       "collection"=>provider_text(source["collection"]),
       "primary_field"=>provider_text(source["primaryField"]),
       "source_principal"=>principal,"source_query"=>query}
    end

    private_class_method :provider_base, :provider_text, :provider_integer,
      :superset_provider_identity, :directus_provider_identity

    # Validate the original receiver envelope before following any original path.
    # Every returned file must resolve to the selected room and native filename.
    def self.check_receipt(receipt, room:, manifest_sha256:)
      Files.need(receipt.is_a?(Hash) && receipt["schema"] == RECEIPT_SCHEMA &&
        receipt["sourceFormat"] == "SF100_SCAN" && receipt["session"].nil? &&
        receipt["room"] == room && receipt["sourceId"] == manifest_sha256 &&
        receipt["manifestSha256"] == manifest_sha256 &&
        HASH.match?(receipt["sourceBindingSha256"].to_s) &&
        receipt["sourceFiles"] == {} && receipt["native"].is_a?(Hash),
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_RECEIPT_CHANGED")
      native = receipt.fetch("native")
      scan, status = native["originalNativeScan"],native["nativeStatus"]
      Files.need(native["schema"] == "stellar-forge.sf100.dataset-delivery.v1" &&
        native["sourceFormat"] == "SF100_SCAN" && native["directory"] == room &&
        native["sourceBindingSha256"] == receipt["sourceBindingSha256"] &&
        scan.is_a?(Hash) && scan["out"] == room && scan["finalized"] == true &&
        scan["nextCursor"].nil? && scan["count"].is_a?(Integer) &&
        scan["count"].between?(0,1_000_000) && scan["total"] == scan["count"] &&
        scan["name"].is_a?(String) && !scan["name"].empty? &&
        %w[snapshot chain queryHash].all? { |key| HASH.match?(scan[key].to_s) } &&
        scan["pages"].is_a?(Array) && scan["pages"].length.between?(1,MAX_PAGES) &&
        scan["fields"].is_a?(Array) && scan["fields"].length.between?(1,64) &&
        scan["fields"].uniq == scan["fields"] && scan["fields"].all? { |field|
          field.is_a?(String) && /\A[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,47}\z/.match?(field)
        } && status.is_a?(Hash) && status["complete"] == true && status["finalized"] == true &&
        status["pages"] == scan["pages"].length && status["rows"] == scan["count"] &&
        status["total"] == scan["total"] && status["snapshot"] == scan["snapshot"] &&
        status["lastRecordDigest"] == scan["chain"], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_COMPLETE_SCAN_REQUIRED")
      Files.need(receipt["columns"].is_a?(Array) &&
        receipt["columns"].map { |column| column.is_a?(Hash) && column["name"] } == scan["fields"] &&
        receipt["columns"].all? { |column|
          %w[string integer number boolean].include?(column["type"]) &&
            [true,false].include?(column["nullable"])
        }, "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_COLUMNS_CHANGED")
      outputs = OUTPUTS + (native["semantics"].nil? ? [] : ["semantics.json"])
      archives = ["session.json"] + Array.new(scan["pages"].length) { |index| format("pages/%05d.json",index) }
      Files.need(native["outputs"].is_a?(Hash) && native["outputs"].keys.sort == outputs.sort &&
        native["archives"].is_a?(Hash) && native["archives"].keys.sort == archives.sort &&
        receipt["archives"] == native["archives"], "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_FILE_SET_CHANGED")
      (outputs + archives).each do |name|
        item = native["outputs"][name] || native["archives"][name]
        check_descriptor(name,item)
        Files.need(item["path"] == File.join(room,name), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SOURCE_PATH_CHANGED")
      end
      Files.need(native["outputs"]["manifest.json"]["sha256"] == manifest_sha256 &&
        archives.drop(1).sum { |name| native["archives"][name]["bytes"] } <= MAX_FILE,
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_SOURCE_MANIFEST_CHANGED")
      [outputs,archives]
    end

    def initialize(directory, raw)
      @directory,@manifest_bytes = directory.freeze,raw.dup.freeze
      @manifest_sha256 = Files.hash(raw).freeze
      @manifest = Files.parse(raw)
      Files.need(@manifest.is_a?(Hash) && @manifest["schema"] == SCHEMA &&
        @manifest["sourceFormat"] == "SF100_SCAN" &&
        %w[datasetId sourceKey].all? { |key| INTENT.match?(@manifest[key].to_s) } &&
        %w[sourceSha256 nativeManifestSha256 sourceBindingSha256 nativeReceiptSha256
          sourceRecordSha256 selectionSha256 snapshot].all? { |key| HASH.match?(@manifest[key].to_s) } &&
        @manifest["sourceSha256"] == @manifest["nativeManifestSha256"] &&
        @manifest["rowCount"].is_a?(Integer) && @manifest["rowCount"].between?(0,1_000_000) &&
        @manifest["fields"].is_a?(Array) && @manifest["files"].is_a?(Array) &&
        @manifest["files"].length.between?(8,MAX_PAGES+10), "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_MANIFEST_INVALID")
      @files = {}
      @manifest["files"].each do |file|
        Files.need(file.is_a?(Hash) && file["name"].is_a?(String) && !@files.key?(file["name"]),
          "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_FILE_DESCRIPTOR_INVALID")
        self.class.check_descriptor(file["name"],file)
        @files[file["name"]] = file
      end
      Files.need((METADATA + OUTPUTS + ["session.json"] - @files.keys).empty?,
        "RUBY_NATIVE_DATASET_COMPLETE_FILES_REQUIRED")
      @selection = json_file("selection.json",limit: self.class.file_limit("selection.json"))
      @source = json_file("source.json",limit: self.class.file_limit("source.json"))
      @native_receipt = json_file("native-receiving.json",limit: self.class.file_limit("native-receiving.json"))
      @native_delivery = @native_receipt["native"]
      @acquisition = nil
      @native_manifest = json_file("manifest.json",limit: self.class.file_limit("manifest.json"))
      @semantics = @files.key?("semantics.json") ? json_file("semantics.json",limit: 2_097_152) : nil
      validate_native_bindings!
      validate_original_rows!
      %w[dataset.csv review.html].each { |name| with_snapshot(name) { |_snapshot| } }
      [@manifest,@files,@selection,@source,@native_receipt,@native_delivery,
        @native_manifest,@semantics].each { |value| self.class.freeze_value(value) }
      membership
    end
    private_class_method :new

    def source_format

    end
    def membership

        "source_format"=>"SF100_SCAN","source_key"=>@manifest.fetch("sourceKey"),
        "dataset"=>@native_manifest.fetch("dataset").fetch("name"),
        "provider_source"=>self.class.provider_identity(@semantics),
